text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"MA","level":"state","category":"security_deposits","status":"in_force","title":"Massachusetts residential security deposit law","requirement":"A security deposit may not exceed the first month's rent. It must be held in a separate interest-bearing account in a Massachusetts bank. The tenant must receive a receipt and a signed statement of condition. Interest is payable at 5% per year, or the lesser amount actually received from the bank, for deposits held one year or longer. The lessor must return the deposit, or the balance after permitted deductions, within 30 days after the tenancy ends. Deductions for damage require a sworn itemized list with cost evidence within the same 30 days. The lessor must keep deposit records for 2 years and transfer the deposit to any successor in interest.
